options.content: Reading the signals · The 2 GB limit includes the Docker VM, observer and host helpers. Container memory is already inside that total. Native Theo/Codex memory is separate. Load test result refers to the last completed qualification; use live memory and headroom for the current state. An unconfigured external monitor cannot detect a whole-laptop outage.
